summary: DarkIris Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that its shareholders approved at an EGM on August 6, 2026, and the company filed on August 14, 2026, a third amended and restated memorandum and articles of association with the Cayman Islands Registrar. The filing contains only the charter amendment and exhibits; no transaction, activist, tender, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure under Rule 13a-16, with no deal terms, pricing, or structural features relevant to event-driven analysis. What to watch: none; this is a ministerial filing.
